attribute.name: NBuffers
attribute.description: Maximum number of events buffered inside the application.

attribute.name: BufferSize_KiB
attribute.description: Initial size of an event buffer, in kibibytes.

attribute.name: RecordingEnabled
attribute.description: Set to false to disable writing data files.

attribute.name: LumiblockEnabled
attribute.description: Set to true to support data streams in which files are closed at luminosity block boundaries.

attribute.name: MaxLumiblockLifetime
attribute.description: Time (s) for which lumiblocks are kept open; after this time, events end up in debug stream LateEvents.

attribute.name: DataDirectories
attribute.description: Directories where the event data files are written. The applications uses them in round-robin, with the time interval specified in DirectoryWritingTime_min.

attribute.name: DirectoryMinFreeSpace
attribute.description: Minimum free space in a directory's volume, as a fraction of the total. The application will not write data to a given directory if this threshold is exceeded.

attribute.name: DirectoryWritingTime_min
attribute.description: Time, in minutes, during which data is written to a directory before switching to the next one.

attribute.name: DirectoryChangeTime_min
attribute.description: Time, in minutes, to complete the change to a new directory for writing data. Remaining open files il the old directory are closed after this time.

attribute.name: MaxEventsPerFile
attribute.description: Maximum number of events in a single output file. Zero means no limit.

attribute.name: MaxFileSize_MiB
attribute.description: Maximum size of an output file, in mebibytes. Zero means no limit.

attribute.name: CompressionAlgorithm
attribute.description: Algorithm used for event-level data compression. Set to NONE to disable.

attribute.name: CompressionLevel
attribute.description: Data compression level (algorithm-specific).

attribute.name: NInputThreads
attribute.description: Number of worker threads. Zero means a number of input threads equal to the hardware threads.

attribute.name: NWorkerThreads
attribute.description: Number of worker threads. Zero means a number of worker threads equal to the hardware threads.

attribute.name: EventTransferTimeout_ms
attribute.description: Timeout, in milliseconds, for the event data to be received after it was requested.

attribute.name: AssignPolicy
attribute.description: Policy for assigning streams to threads.

attribute.name: StreamWeightPeriod
attribute.description: Sliding window period in seconds for computing the streams' weight.

attribute.name: IOServiceWeightPeriod
attribute.description: Sliding window period in seconds for computing the IO services' weight.

attribute.name: Adler32MtNbThreads
attribute.description: Number of threads for parallel adler32 computation

attribute.name: Adler32MtThreshold
attribute.description: Threshold (bytes) above which adler32 requests are actually distributed to multiple threads

attribute.name: UnlockDirDbSync
attribute.description: If true, data directories are unlocked when all db updates are committed

attribute.name: ExtraParameters
attribute.description: Additional expert parameters.
